title: Selected Topics in German Studies; Introduction to German Linguistics
description:
Prerequisite: GERS302.

Provides a comprehensive introduction to German linguistics, the scientific study of language as applied to German. The course covers key linguistics concepts through the German language from synchronic, diachronic, and sociolinguistic perspectives, followed by a creative language project. Students will build and demonstrate their understanding of linguistic principles through discussion, activities, and completion of exercises. No prior experience with linguistics is required or expected. Taught in German.
